description: This file contains utility classes for running and testing generated PyTorch programs, including handling output, error reporting, and GPU device selection.

classes.name: ProgramRunner
classes.description: A class that runs generated PyTorch programs, manages output/error reporting, and handles GPU device selection.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for ProgramRunner, currently does nothing.

methods.name: run_program
methods.description: Runs a specified Python program, manages output, errors, and GPU device selection, and exits on failure.

methods.name: run_and_validate
methods.description: Runs a specified Python program and returns detailed success/failure information without exiting.
